author: toketrain
body:
im gonna use yellowstone as an example here because i see what im talkin about mostly on that map- in the loadout, each team recieves a block of lapis. but yellow team sometimes takes the lapis and dyes their armor to match cyans, thus having an unfair advantage. they can easily sneak over to cyan's side disguised as one of them, all it takes is putting your yellow armor in with lapis four times to get cyan armor.
in maps like these, maybe the loadout should include 9 dandelions too? it's not huge but it could be pretty unfair if abused right, right?
